organizations.name: Mac Properties
organizations.description: Property management company that owns/operates apartment building where narrator lived. Suspected connections to casinos and clubs in Westport area. Also has properties in Chicago. Narrator also sent an email to the 'executives' with a cockroach research prompt and suggestions for improving their laundry room.
concerns: Ticket appeared at casino without being given
Suspected ownership of clubs and casinos
Potential camera access across properties
Water contamination from cockroaches not being addressed. Likely influence over local government/police.
Doorway repairs started after conversations

perspectives.interpretation: Central organization connecting apartments, clubs, and casinos for potential money laundering operation
perspectives.reasoning: Ticket connection between apartment and casino, camera access, club ownership theories

perspectives.interpretation: Large real estate company with diverse holdings

notes: Outside looks good but inside questionable

organizations.name: TransitPros
organizations.description: Towing software company where narrator worked. Extremely poor security practices. Worked with Copart. Questionable legitimacy. Coworker told me a story of his younger life of working for a loan shark who eventually became mayor. He became a policeman and got kicked off the force after giving his son a ticket. Claims this was in Denver and he moved away from there.
concerns: Terrible code quality and security
Sending gift cards instead of real payments
Form entry was terrible
Had EIN information for many towing vendors with no security
Did not see actual users on observability implementation
Accounting separated from software

perspectives.interpretation: Potentially a shell company for money laundering
perspectives.reasoning: Gift cards instead of payments, few visible employees, poor security could be intentional

perspectives.interpretation: Just a poorly run organization with no idea how to build software
Cover for observation due to towing industry connection to national security

notes: Worked with Copart as primary company
Narrator learned a lot about engagement, motivation, AI, observability
